bounds_status_rules.gain: CURRENT minus GTFREE paired scene AbsRel
bounds_status_rules.interaction: DID=boundsgain(max)-boundsgain(1k). If DID stable in either direction OR first/last bounds stable gain sign flips => INTERACTION_WITH_OPTIMIZATION. Otherwise max-budget stable gain => GT_FREE_BETTER, reverse=>CURRENT_BETTER, else NO_CLEAR_DIFFERENCE.

hindsight_query_best: Optional offline diagnostic only; never primary configuration or checkpoint selection

optimization_status_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Otherwise; no global optimization or expressivity impossibility proof.
optimization_status_rules.PARTIALLY_SATURATED: At least one earlier adjacent query gain stable; last gain not stable and reverse last gain not stable.
optimization_status_rules.QUERY_OVERFIT: Last adjacent query harm is stable practical gain in reverse AND >=75% scenes context full objective improves.
optimization_status_rules.SATURATED: Max-budget plateau fraction >=.75 AND last query and context AbsRel gain CIs entirely within [-.02,.02].
optimization_status_rules.UNDEROPTIMIZED: Last adjacent query gain stable AND all prior adjacent mean query gains >=0 AND max-budget plateau fraction <.75.

secondary: RGB_ONLY only primary configuration after primary analysis, never changes primary decisions

statistics.unit: scene; average query then A/B, scenes equal
